paper: FlowMap-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Few-Step Flow-Map Generators, arXiv:2609.37851 (preprint source: Flowmap_OPD_arxiv/main.tex)

text_and_numbers.stat tiles: abstract and contributions list of main.tex (3 specialists, 300 updates, OCR 0.883 vs 0.850 on FLUX, ImageNet FID 22.68 to 18.23)

figures.edit: resized to 1200 px wide for link previews

charts.generator: tools/make_charts.py (light and dark SVG per chart; same data and encodings as the paper's plotting scripts in Flowmap_OPD/figures/plot_src)
charts.assets/fig/consolidation_gain_*.svg: consolidation_gain.py, fig:consolidation-gain; values of the two three-teacher tables and the FLUX student's EMA evaluations
charts.assets/fig/two_teacher_grpo_*.svg: two_teacher_grpo.py, fig:two-teacher-grpo; data resolved once from /mnt/data/zhiqili/wm_post-training/setup/plot_data into tools/data/two_teacher_grpo.json

gallery.selection: Selected examples. FLUX.1: chosen by eye among the 66 paired samples. SD3.5: chosen by eye among the samples that pass the recorded-score rule of their task.
gallery.processing: each tile is the full 512x512 output re-encoded as WebP (quality 84); thumbnails are 120 px copies of the student image; no crop, no retouching

flux.grpo: FlowMap-GRPO on three rewards, EMA update 1500 (tr3_pfs_fx)
flux.nft: MeanFlowNFT on three rewards, EMA update 750 (tr3_mfn_fx)
flux.opd: FlowMap-OPD student, EMA update 300; lambda_c per example in student_checkpoint

sd35_rules.ocr: OCR reward of the OCR teacher and of the student >= 0.999 on this sample
sd35_rules.geneval: GenEval accuracy of the GenEval teacher and of the student = 1 on this sample
sd35_rules.pickscore: PickScore: teacher >= base + 1.0, student >= teacher - 0.3 and student >= both models trained on the three rewards
